artifact_kind: editorial source-data chart; not an app screenshot
title: A measured material trade-off

source.title: Dataset of the properties of polyethylene (PE) blends of different densities mixed with post-consumer recycled polyethylene (PCRPE)
source.process: Virgin PE and commercially sourced post-consumer recycled PE were manually blended at the stated weight fractions and injection moulded as ASTM Type I dogbones on a Battenfeld HM90/350 90-ton horizontal machine, using the reported 185–195 °C profile.
source.test_method: Source section 2.5: tensile testing of ten individually loaded ASTM Type I dogbones per blend on an Autograph AGS-J with a 5 kN load cell and MWG-5kNA wedge grips, at 500 mm/min crosshead speed. The source states ambient 22 °C unless otherwise noted.
source.sample_count_source_location: Article section 1, Data Description; section 2.5, Electromechanical testing

series.constant_source_context: One source study and common reported process; virgin MDPE supplies the remainder at 0–80 wt% PCRPE.
series.shared_endpoint_note: The 100% PCRPE endpoint has no virgin host and is the same stored condition in all four series.
